name: Selecta-T Octa Joint bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 328 g for BB-SL31 Octa Joint bottom-bracket parts in the Adamas AX FC-AD11/FC-AD21 assembly table, separately from the chainwheel/crank figures. The weighed spindle/shell variant is not identified; this is not a square-taper reference.
